verdict.rationale: The only direct evidence of a built-in assistant is a single pricing-page line listing an "Agentic creative collaborator" (runway-docs-32). Nothing describes what tasks it accepts, how delegation works, or which plans include it. The other agent-related items don't count toward this story: MCP and coding-agent plugins let external agents connect in, Characters are developer building blocks for avatars, and Recipes and Ads are prebuilt automations rather than an assistant. Missing for 10: documentation of the assistant's capabilities and delegation workflow, the scope of tasks it can run on its own, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
